name: Pastpaper AI - WebApp
abstract: Transforming exam preparation with AI-powered past paper analysis. A PWA powered Exam preparation app
description: Pastpaper.AI was born from a simple observation: students spend countless hours studying, but often without direction. We asked ourselves, 'What if AI could analyze years of past exam papers and tell students exactly what topics are most likely to appear?' That question led us to build the intelligent study companion that students can rely on for their exam preparation.

name: K Electrical - Website
abstract: A modern website for an electrical and electronics engineering company for a client done and delivered.
description: The client wanted an online presence, that will make their clients be able to acccess them and have a look of their services on the fly. We made the website easy to navigate, access services, book a service, ask for a quaotation, and be answered instantly through an automated emailing system. We added a dashboard where the client would be able to access the reviews from clients, manage sent bookings, and answer quoatation related emails right in their dashboard.

name: Williams Kaphika - The Pysics Paradox Blog - Website
abstract: A blogging site for Williams Kaphika of The Physics Paradox, where he shares his insights on education, health, technology and science
description: Williams Kaphika is an educator, researcher and a blogger, so when he asked to work on his blogging website from scratch, to replace his wordpress powered one we took the task and delivered. The blog has a dashboard for managing posts, adding posts, managing subscribers overall manage the site's perfomance and analytics.

name: Activit Flow - WebApp
abstract: A client and activity tracking and management webapp.
description: Through the combination of Google's Firebase and vercels incredible technology this webapp makes managing day to day activities seam a bliss. Targeted for the busy and forgetful working class people and tired students to manage their, clients, meetings, classes, exams and any day to day activities. Who wants to keep track of things in their head when tech can do it easily, and remind you in an instant. Activity flow is your cheap personal assistant

name: Weightless - Fitness Tracker - WebApp
abstract: A webapp for tracking weight loss and fitness of people. With realtime steps counter.
description: Weightless is a simple but intuitive fitness tracking PWA powered app that offers realtime steps counter, weight loss predictions based on recent activities, analytics, an automated BMI calculator, notification reminders, simple to manage and get started, no bloat but just the tools to get you ready for your next weight loss adventure. With industry standard technology under the hood weightless is engineered for accuracy and precision.

name: Custom Made BirthDay App
abstract: A birthday app for a girl's birhday custom made per the client's recommendations delivered.
description: The Client's idea for the app; was simple, make it memorable and gamified but less clunky, simple and classy and should work as inteded and the app was made with that in mind and the client was happy on how it turned out.

name: Quachema
abstract: A social media platform which connects different backgrounds to one hub
description: Quachema was built to be a modern social platform inspired by the Malawian slang 'Kwachema' meaning that place is fire. Its where conversations spark, content spreads, and communities come alive. When something is funny, exciting, trending, or worth talking about, it belongs on Quachema

name: Nsikacart
abstract: Nsikacart is a full-stack marketplace web applicatiion that allows users to list, manage, and purchase products in a structured online marketplace environment.
description: Nsikacart is a full-stack e-commerce marketplace built with and a custom PHP API. It features Cloudinary image storage, admin-based user verification, wishlist functionality, and a fully decoupled deployment architecture.
